headline: IKEA Annual Sales Fall 2% to €43.8 Billion as CEO Vows Growth Strategy
summary: IKEA reported sales of €43.8 billion across 64 countries for the financial year ending August 31, marking a 2 percent decline compared to 2025 and its third consecutive year of falling sales.
why: Retail sales figures from major global furniture chains indicate consumer spending trends in home goods across international markets.

impacts.name: Retail sector
impacts.why: A three-year sales decline at a major global home furnishings retailer reflects softer consumer demand in retail.
